verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order (crowd, then quote, then attribution) and fills the portrait canvas well, but the quote has an orphaned 'INDEED,' line and very loose leading, the attribution's two lines are set much tighter than the quote and wrap awkwardly, and the crowd strip is cut off hard at the top and sides. B flips the order and jams the quote against the left and right edges (the first line almost touches the right edge), with the attribution crammed right under the quote. It also has the same orphaned 'INDEED,' line, a crowd band with a flat cut-off bottom edge, and the whole bottom third of the canvas is dead white space, so the layout looks lopsided and unfinished.
